description: This PHP class defines a Currency style wizard for formatting currency numbers in PhpSpreadsheet, allowing customization of currency symbols, placement, spacing, decimals, and locale.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class that provides currency formatting options for numbers, including symbol placement, spacing, and locale settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize currency formatting options such as currency code, decimals, separator, symbol position, spacing, and locale.

methods.name: setCurrencyCode
methods.description: Sets the currency symbol or code used for formatting.

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolPosition
methods.description: Defines whether the currency symbol appears before or after the number.

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolSpacing
methods.description: Specifies whether there is spacing between the currency symbol and the number.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates the formatted currency string based on current settings.
